posts.label: ONE SIGNAL
posts.hook_1: The 3pm crash, the evening cravings, the fat that will not shift.
posts.sub_1: Not three problems. One signal.

posts.label: TELL 01
posts.hook_1: Energy drops hard between 2 and 4pm.
posts.sub_1: And it is not about how you slept.

posts.hook_1: Insulin sensitivity is one of the most responsive systems in the body.

posts.label: NOT THE CARBS
posts.hook_1: It is not how many carbs. It is when, and what they sit next to.
posts.sub_1: Cutting them is the first thing people try and rarely the thing that was wrong.

posts.label: TELL 02
posts.hook_1: Heavy and foggy for about an hour after eating.
posts.sub_1: Particularly after lunch.

posts.hook_1: That is a timing strategy, not a restriction strategy.

posts.label: TELL 04
